subject: President Joe Biden, apparently telling New Hampshire Democrats to skip the primary
called_fake_by: New Hampshire officials and the Biden campaign
claim: Two days before the primary, thousands of voters got robocalls in a voice like Biden's telling them to save their vote for November. Officials said the calls were fake.
finding: The voice was cloned with AI. Political consultant Steve Kramer admitted organizing the calls. He said he wanted to draw attention to the dangers of AI in campaigns.
outcome: The FCC proposed a $6 million penalty against Kramer in May 2024 and imposed it that September, over the spoofed caller ID. In a separate civil settlement, the telecom company that carried the calls agreed to pay $1 million. In the state criminal case, a jury found Kramer not guilty of all charges in June 2025.
